compiler.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]

evaluator.budget_unit: one explicit source-machine step; a terminal return consumes no further budget

wasm.parameters: live enum ordinals only; erased parameters omitted
wasm.empty_matches: i32.const 0 in a region with no domain-valid execution; remains inside the eight-instruction knot-enum-1 whitelist

output_policy: The compiler opens the requested output only after complete checking and bounded emission; semantic failure and exhaustion leave existing output untouched. File-write failures are HostFailure and may leave an incomplete file, never a Built result. Callers must use the exit status, not file presence, as evidence of a fresh artifact.
external_argument_domain: Each live evaluator ordinal must designate a nullary constructor of its declared type; eval-cli reports HostFailure structured-argument for fielded constructor ordinals. The Node adapter accepts only enum-signatured host calls: live arity and profile-wide 0..255 are checked, while declared signature and per-type domain remain caller preconditions.
later_milestones: broader recursion beyond first-parameter field descent

structural_recursion.rule: First checked self-call argument must be a Reference to a strict field descendant of parameter 0, or a rebuilt Value/Construct that denotes one (its refinement unfolded layer by layer: same types, tags and field levels in order); matches propagate descendant levels.
structural_recursion.forward_and_mutual_calls: Unchanged; live forward calls are Invalid check forward-live-call.
structural_recursion.contract_note: This rule supersedes two sentences of tests/compiler-recursion/SPEC.md: that reconstructed constructors do not satisfy the rule, and that reconstruction of a strict descendant does not qualify once its checked term is no longer a Reference. Since nest round 4 (3a35051) a rebuilt Value/Construct that denotes a strict descendant qualifies; rebuilt parents and rebuilt non-descendants still report Unsupported check recursive-call. The recursion SPEC belongs to another increment and is unamended here; the amendment is left to the coordinator and the campaign/descent-2 integration.

structural_terms.patterns: ordered binary first-match matrices over multiple scrutinees, wildcard/variable rows and nested constructors; optional comma separators; plain/+ binders share lexical identities; _ is anonymous; all-variable columns on the latest let binder alias without inspection; erased fields stay erased
structural_terms.observation: Live-field projection, declaration order; erased fields omitted

fields_wasm.arguments: source output [characters parser-depth checker-depth emitter-depth output-bytes]
fields_wasm.budgets: Same defaults and maximum overrides as compiler; profile selection is explicit.
fields_wasm.enum_entry_unchanged: src/compile-cli.bend calls emit, which selects Enum{} and retains enum_profile rejection.
fields_wasm.enum_only_book_bytes: Identical to knot-enum-1; 25 frozen module hashes checked in both compiler lanes.

representation.fielded_type: i32 address of [tag][live fields in declaration order], one 4-byte word each
representation.zero_address: Valid cell address, not a null sentinel

arena.guard: unsigned size > 65536 - bump; the only unreachable in the profile
arena.allocation: Arguments saved before allocation; stores after bounded pointer advance
arena.lifetime: Instance lifetime; immutable initialized cells; no free, reset, growth or reclamation

fields_wasm.exports: All original functions, unchanged indices; allocator appended and unexported; no memory or global exports.
fields_wasm.host_precondition: Checked Knot module of selected profile; invoke only enum-only live parameter/result signatures with valid per-type ordinals. Structured functions are for compiled callers. Adapter cannot enforce signature provenance.

host_outcomes.node_startup_failure: Outside adapter classification; not a successful execution

fields_wasm.recursion: first-parameter structural descent, including nested pattern fields
fields_wasm.proof_boundary: Five checked capability/representation/erasure helper laws, not general compiler or memory refinement.
fields_wasm.empty_matches: i32.const 0; no domain-valid execution reaches the empty branch

module_loading.legacy_commands: Existing single-file forms keep their arguments, limits and exit codes. Their diagnostics change where the module rules apply: let and arm binders named like an earlier constructor report Invalid check constructor-pattern-binder (let binders were accepted, arm binders Unsupported check variable-pattern); a field binder named like a later constructor is accepted (was Invalid); the declaration-order binder walk is bounded at 65536 work steps (Exhausted check); a result type longer than one name reports Unsupported parse result-type (was Invalid parse function-result); a spaced '- >' arrow reports Invalid parse function-result (was accepted); parent-relative imports report Unsupported parse import (was Invalid parse declaration-name); '&' or '|' after a parameter or field type reports Unsupported parse parameter-type (was Invalid parse argument-separator), as an application or arrow there already did; an application, arrow, '&' or '|' after a typed-let type reports Unsupported parse binding-type (was Invalid parse expected-=); an unbound dotted let, typed-let or field binder reports Invalid check dotted-binder (was accepted); a binder named in a later type position of its scope reports Invalid check binder-as-type (was accepted); a declared type or function used as an unapplied term reports Unsupported check type-as-term or Unsupported check function-reference (was Invalid check free-name).
module_loading.legacy_commands_decision: Accepted by the coordinator on 2026-09-28: each single-file change moves Knot toward the seed's verdict and is pinned by seed-derived fixtures (tests/compiler-modules/REVIEW-ROUND-5.md#single-file-deltas; the dotted-binder row in REVIEW-ROUND-6.md). Review round 7's findings asked for the binder-as-type and declared-global rows (tests/compiler-modules/REVIEW-ROUND-7.md#single-file-deltas).
module_loading.bundle: Explicit frozen local directory standing in for BEND_LIB; no network or named-package resolution.
module_loading.identity: Lexically normalized filesystem path after a host query checks exact directory-entry spelling and no symlink components; ambiguous paths report Unsupported load path-identity. Entry and bundle roots are queried before normalization. A relative entry, bundle root or import target that still climbs above the working directory after normalization has no canonical spelling and reports Unsupported load path-identity; the working directory itself (--bundle .) contains every relative path. A bundle root that normalizes to the root directory reports Unsupported load root-bundle, since the seed's prefix for it contains nothing. As in the seed, one empty segment after a leading ./ or hash head (.//x.bend, 0x<hash>//x.bend) names the single-slash module; any other empty segment is Invalid load import-path.
module_loading.output: compile --bundle opens the output only after loading. A symlinked, case-inexact or climbing output reports HostFailure arguments output-path; an output naming the entry, a loaded module or the Base path (equal on one basis, or an absolute spelling ending with the relative one) reports HostFailure arguments source-is-output.
module_loading.namespaces: Local modules relative to entry directory; bundle modules relative to bundle root; aliases are file-local.
module_loading.declaration_order: Dependency-first ordered stream; all user definitions checked, including unused definitions; completed paths are loaded once and active back edges rejected.

base.pin: Runtime Bend SHA-256 over bounded ASCII input, before inventory construction.
base.registration: Book-global from first import event, with distinct type/function and constructor namespaces. Both bare and qualified user declarations, and the later Base inventory, reject same-category collisions.
base.slice: Transitive dependencies of every user declaration; selected Base source is parsed and checked in the combined book.
base.trust_inventory: After combined checking, audit records BasePin, Module paths, BaseChecked names and exact BaseUnchecked complement.
base.unsupported: Reachable features outside the language yield specific Unsupported reasons; no unchecked acceptance or substitute prelude.

limits.base_slice: Finite dependency work bound derived from parser depth.

module_loading.proof_boundary: Path, scope, transition, selection and digest helper laws; not whole-graph confluence, SHA-256 refinement or compiler correctness.
module_loading.foreign_effects: Existing IO/file effects plus src/path-host.bend::inspect, a minimal native/Bun filesystem identity query. It observes component spelling and symlinks only; classification stays in Bend. No environment lookup or network is added.
module_loading.wasm_profile: Existing enum emitter; importing a book adds no fielded or recursive Wasm capability.

pattern_matrix.lowering_law: src/lowering-LAWS.bend::irrefutable_first_row_selected, filled in src/lowering-PROOF.bend and imported by the matrix proof entry
pattern_matrix.core: Binary Decision with live Remainder scopes, checked then coalesced into exhaustive core Case; Matrix, Decision, Remainder and Alias never enter runtime core
pattern_matrix.bounds: 4096 residual-matrix visits per expanded source match, including leaves and empty remainders; Expansion threads the unused total through both branches without division. Each separately reached source match starts a new budget; checker/expansion depth and lexical-level limits remain. The checked core of a source match has a budget of its own: 65,536 nodes, one unit per node with every copy of a shared default counted (core Case has no default arm, so a terminal default is copied into each remaining constructor's branch and the core grows as the product of the columns' constructors); more is Exhausted check budget, decided on the finished match before any consumer of the core reads it, and a nested match counts inside the match that holds it (src/check.bend::core_budget, weight, budgeted; src/check-LAWS.bend::weight_counts_every_node, weight_stops_when_spent; tests/compiler-nest/round13-expectations.json default-* fixtures). The bootstrap corpus (1,771 Bend files before round 13's fixtures) reaches at most 113 nodes in a match (wide-type-depth3.bend; then self-shape.bend, 75), and no src/*.bend file reaches a matrix (each stops in the lexer or the parser), so none is Exhausted by it.
unmet: rec-swapped-args: Unsupported check recursive-call, frozen Invalid expectation unchanged
rec-alias: Unsupported check recursive-call, frozen Invalid expectation unchanged
General law: every exhaustive matrix lowers without a missing branch (only helper laws and exhaustive_matrix_witness are proved; open obligation, D21)

General law in its total form: a matrix whose first row is irrefutable lowers to that row's body (only its partial-correctness part is proved; open obligation, D21). The total form is false at the fixed 4096-visit quota: the frozen control tests/compiler-nest/controls/matrix-work.bend (13 columns, first row all _, body On{}; the seed prints On{}) reports Exhausted check budget, because column_step splits on any constructor head even when the first row is irrefutable (T(n+1)=2+2T(n), 24,574 visits). It is dischargeable only relative to sufficient work, or once expansion stops splitting a matrix whose first row is irrefutable, a change to that frozen control that needs coordinator review. The total form is also false at the core budget: the same all-wildcard-first shape at nine columns with five constructors per column (a first row all _, then one-hot rows; the seed prints On{}) checks a core of 5^9 leaves and reports Exhausted check budget (tests/compiler-nest/round13-expectations.json default-dd9x5-first; default-dd4x5-first stays Accepted)
pattern_matrix.defaults: The negative branch excludes one constructor and retains the live unrefined lexical binding. A variable row is checked even when its remainder is empty. A missing arm is dead code only when a live binder outside the pending suffix of the match frontier (which starts at the scrutinee) has an empty constructor set: an emptied residual or a zero-constructor datatype. Dead code never bypasses body checking.
pattern_matrix.names: Names are words joined by dots (Invalid lex name otherwise); pattern binders and live let binders are single words, and every dotted binder (a pattern, a `+` promotion, a let, a typed let) is Unsupported parse dotted-binder, because the seed accepts one that rebinds a name in scope and the parser does not resolve scopes (src/LAWS.bend::dotted_pattern_binder, dotted_promotion_binder, dotted_let_binder, dotted_typed_let_binder, unnamed_binder_is_invalid). Match and case headers join lines up to their colon. A constructor's { must touch its name in patterns and bodies (Invalid parse detached-brace otherwise); joined header tokens keep their offsets, so a line break never bridges that gap. A bare pattern binder may not be a declared constructor, and `+` may not name a datatype declared earlier in the file (Invalid check datatype-pattern-binder), in a row, a field, a `+` let and a discarded body (src/catalog.bend::binder, promotion). A binder in scope hides a datatype of its name from the types written after it: an annotation, a later parameter type, the result type and a later field type are Invalid check type-shadowed (src/catalog.bend::hidden).
pattern_matrix.audit: Every row of every match is validated, reachable or not, as the seed parses the whole book before checking a body: one pattern per scrutinee, a declared constructor with its field count, no constructor as a bare binder, no call as a pattern, at every depth of a discarded body, through lets and nested matches (src/matrix.bend::audit; Invalid check pattern-arity, unknown-constructor, constructor-pattern-binder, pattern-form, datatype-pattern-binder). A discarded body is not type-, scope- or scrutinee-checked.
pattern_matrix.unsupported: A new source match on a residual binding reports Unsupported check default-scrutinee until source-level residual constructor sets are carried through nested matches. A line break inside call or constructor arguments reports Unsupported parse line-break, and a second case arm on an arm's line Unsupported parse same-line-arm; the seed accepts both, and both refine former Invalid parse outcomes (src/LAWS.bend::line_break_in_arguments, line_break_after_element, same_line_arm, body_ends_at_line_break). Arguments separated by whitespace alone (`two(a b)`, `Pr{a b}`; a name or a numeral, or in a pattern a marking `+`, after an argument) report Unsupported parse argument-whitespace, a promotion of a promotion (`++y`, `+ +y`, `++u = x`) repeated-promotion, and a line break in a let (before its `=`, before its value, between its marker and its name) line-break; the seed accepts them all. An arm body that starts with a term (a name, `match`, `+`, `-`, `(`, `[`, a numeral or `?`) on the line after its case, at the case's column or below it, and a later statement at another column, report Unsupported parse body-indentation: the seed takes any term as a body and checks no column (src/syntax.bend::body_start; src/LAWS.bend::body_start_witness, arm_body_may_start_with_a_term, closer_starts_no_body; tests/compiler-nest/round13-grid.json). A closer, a separator, a keyword, `!`, `@` and a backslash start no term and stay Invalid, as does an empty arm. A case at, left of or at the margin of its match reports Unsupported parse pattern-or-indentation; a let split before its `:` or `=` (marker or plain name) line-break; a statement on the line of a let's value same-line-statement; a numeral opening a later column of a row, or a term after a header's scrutinee that is no closer, separator or keyword, term-form (a Nat literal pattern has no form); a parenthesis that starts a line in a header (the header joins its lines; the seed reads it as the next term, not a call's arguments) term-form, or argument-whitespace among call or constructor arguments; a def or type at another column top-level-indentation, and one on the line of a body's end same-line-declaration (src/parse.bend; tests/compiler-nest/round11-expectations.json). After a complete term the seed reads an infix operator, a call, an index, an offload !( and, after a name, a lambda, and +name and +(name) as a promoted variable (also across the line break after the +), and a line that starts with an operator, !( or => continues the term before it; a body the lowering discards holds any of them unchecked and a live one needs a target the program defines (a live row rejects an operator for its type, which is no syntax claim). Wherever a term ends, in a body, a let's value (on its line, or a line that starts with the operator), an argument or a scrutinee, an operator token is Unsupported parse operator, the seed's sugar that Knot does not model, and every other form (a call, an index, an offload, a lambda, a +name term) is Unsupported parse term-form (src/parse.bend::suffix, operator, continues, form, lambda, promoted_term; src/LAWS.bend::suffix_witness, continues_witness, lambda_witness, promoted_term_witness, suffix_ends_a_body, call_ends_a_body, suffix_ends_a_let, call_ends_a_let, promoted_term_is_unsupported; tests/compiler-nest/round12-expectations.json, round13-expectations.json). After an expression argument the seed reads x +y and the glued x+y as the same tokens, x and the promoted term +y, and ?y as a hole: +y is term-form (operator when the + touches the argument, src/parse.bend::abuts), ?y term-form; @y, a backslash, -y and a closer are no term and stay Invalid parse argument-separator, as does anything after a pattern's field, which the seed always validates (src/LAWS.bend::argument_promotion_is_unsupported, glued_argument_operator_is_unsupported, argument_hole_is_unsupported, argument_at_is_invalid). A closer, ==, => after a constructor, a marker touching a name after a complete body, a lone . or !, a [ or ( where only a declaration may start and an erased -name stay Invalid. Open D4 gaps, all seed-accepted and Invalid: a def header's parameters and a type's fields (the layout-def-header continuation, owned by the literals-layout increment), an unindented def body (the frontend gate pins it Invalid), a call with fewer arguments than parameters that the seed reads as an unused partial application (check call-arity), a global function used as a value (check free-name), a Nat literal pattern as a let binder at another column, a constructor line of a type declaration at another column.
pattern_matrix.promotion: A + row makes a lambda-case binder (a parameter or field) reusable with every alias of its level; a let binder and its aliases keep the let's declared quantity under any row (src/matrix-LAWS.bend::parameter_alias_promotes, let_alias_keeps_quantity). A + mark may raise a frontier binder past its type's kind; as in the seed, the kind is judged only where the match frontier binds the binder: leaving it undestructured, ahead of a later matched binder (flat match, matrix split or zero-row match) or at a body that is not a match, a let included (src/patterns.bend::advance and close; src/matrix-LAWS.bend::destructured_promotion_is_unbound, later_match_binds_promotion, leaf_binds_promotion). A promoted Type-kind binder destructured first is never bound; its fields carry the promoted quantity. A split's field binders are those of the first row that starts its constructor (src/matrix.bend::leading, marked): a + on one of them marks that field in every row below the split and at every later split of the remaining rows, and a + in a later row marks only its own binder (src/matrix-LAWS.bend::first_row_marks_witness, unmarked_first_row_witness).
pattern_matrix.let_inference: An unannotated let infers its value, and a checked Value or Construct term has no inferred type: a binder that a positive branch refined to a constructor, flat or in a matrix, through an alias, a nested field level or an enclosing match, needs an annotation (Invalid check annotation-required, as a literal constructor does). A residual or default-row binder, a field never split, a later parameter, a call and an annotated let stay inferable (src/check.bend::expected; src/check-LAWS.bend::refined_value_needs_annotation, refined_construct_needs_annotation, unrefined_binder_is_inferable, annotation_admits_constructor; src/matrix-LAWS.bend::refined_flat_let_witness, refined_matrix_let_witness, residual_let_witness, annotated_let_witness).
pattern_matrix.glue: The seed reads `+` and `-` as a marker only where a name follows directly, and a return arrow as the literal `->` (src/syntax.bend::marks; src/parse.bend::promotes). After a term in a pattern row a `+` that does not touch its binder ends the row (Invalid parse expected-:), so `a + b` is rejected while `a +b`, a promotion that starts a row or follows a comma, and one inside fields stay accepted. After a let, the seed reads a spaced + or - as an operator on the previous value: when a name and = or : follow it the seed rejects the pair and the marker is Invalid parse detached-marker, and any other operand is Unsupported parse operator; first in a body, and in a parameter list, it may be spaced (src/LAWS.bend::marks_witness, detached_plus, detached_marker, spaced_operator_after_a_let, first_marker). A split arrow is Invalid parse function-result (src/LAWS.bend::split_arrow).
open_obligations: Irrefutable first row (D21): unproved general law in its total form, which includes that the lowering succeeds; the partial-correctness part is proved by src/lowering-LAWS.bend::irrefutable_first_row_selected; witnessed by irrefutable_lowering_witness, irrefutable_first_row_witness, the first-match, wildcard and variable fixtures and the 3,000-program seed fuzz. Counterexample to the total form at the implemented quota: the frozen control matrix-work (a 13-column matrix whose first row is 13 _ with body On{}, accepted by the seed with On{}) exhausts the fixed 4096-visit quota (Exhausted check budget), because expansion splits on a constructor head in any row even when the first row is irrefutable (24,574 visits). The control's Exhausted is Knot's cost model applied to a seed-accepted program (a D4 resource limit, not an Invalid). So the total obligation holds only relative to sufficient work (a quota at least the expansion's visits) and stays undischargeable as stated until expansion selects an irrefutable first row without splitting, which changes the frozen control and needs coordinator review. The core budget is a second cost model of the same kind: a matrix whose first row is irrefutable but that has one-hot rows over five constructors in each of nine columns lowers to a core the budget refuses (Exhausted check budget), though the seed accepts it

Exhaustive matrix (D21): unproved general law that an exhaustive matrix lowers to a tree with no missing branch; witnessed by exhaustive_matrix_witness, the remainder helper laws, the multi, nested, rec-nested and empty fixtures and the 3,000-program seed fuzz
